description: PROPOSED content obligations for the Rehearsal 009 successor amendment (ODR-V413-01). Not authoritative: the owner approves or declines them. Requirement ids CONTENT-* are proposed; sourceRequirements cite the existing frozen baseline requirements each one makes verifiable.

suites.fixture: the deployed candidate at the exact SHA and the authorized GitHub test repository; one fresh investigation per test
the test build with the stateful GitHub fake

obligations.criterion: Through the UI, a user creates an investigation by entering a required name, an optional description and an optional primary question; the application assigns a stable identifier that is not derived from the name.
Until the save protocol confirms the commit (PERSIST-007 read-back), the investigation is shown as a local draft (Unsaved/Saving), never as Saved.
A user edits the name, description and primary question; after save and reload the edited values are shown and the investigation identifier is unchanged.

A user adds an observation with required text, optional notes and optional source reference; it receives a stable identifier, and reopening it shows the entered text, not an event label or sequence number.
A user adds a hypothesis with a required statement and optional explanation; it receives a stable identifier and is visually and semantically distinct from observations and conclusions.
A user records a textual evidence item with a label, a substantive description, a source reference, an optional source URL and an optional date; it is independently identifiable and viewable.
A user links an evidence item to a hypothesis as supports, contradicts or relevant-without-direction; the link persists and is shown on both the evidence and the hypothesis after reload.
A user enters a substantive conclusion statement, shown distinctly from hypotheses; the existing review, evidence and causal-analysis gates still decide whether the investigation can be resolved.

Editing an observation, hypothesis or evidence item records a revision event: the entity identifier is unchanged, the current text is the revised text, and the earlier text and its provenance remain in the history.
After verified persistence, a reload from GitHub in a new browser context shows the same name, description, question, observation, hypothesis, evidence and relationship content the user entered.

Missing investigation name, empty observation, empty hypothesis, an invalid source URL and a relationship to a non-existent target are refused with a visible, field-level message, and nothing is saved.
A duplicate submission of the same content (double tap, retry) records it once.

A save failure, a GitHub authentication failure, a concurrent-edit conflict and a reload of missing or malformed data each show their state, keep the user's entered content, and offer the recovery action; none is reported as Saved.
At 320 px and 390 px widths every content form is usable: labelled fields, visible focus, touch targets of at least 44 px, long text wraps, and no control overflows its container or the viewport.
